Compute Clustering Deviation Index (CDI) for Single-Cell Clustering Evaluation

Source: R/03_metrics_clustering.R
calc_cdi.Rd

Evaluates the unsupervised goodness-of-fit of single-cell clustering labels directly on count matrices using the official Bioconductor CDI package (Fang et al., Genome Biology, 2022; DOI: 10.1186/s13059-022-02825-5). CDI models UMI counts under cluster- and gene-specific Negative Binomial distributions adjusted by cell size factors, returning AIC- and BIC-penalized deviation scores.

Usage

calc_cdi(
  counts,
  cluster_labels,
  batch_label = NULL,
  size_factors = NULL,
  nfeature = 500L,
  method = c("wds", "vst"),
  zp_threshold = 0.95,
  lrt_pval_threshold = 0.01,
  max_cells = 1000L,
  normalize_per_obs = TRUE,
  threads = 1L,
  seed = 42L,
  top_features = NULL
)

Arguments

counts

Count matrix (matrix, sparse dgCMatrix, or SingleCellExperiment; genes x cells or cells x genes).

cluster_labels

Vector or factor of cluster / cell-type assignments for each cell.

batch_label

Optional vector or factor of batch assignments for each cell (enables CDI's batch-common vs. batch-specific NB likelihood ratio test).

size_factors

Optional numeric vector of positive cell-specific size factors. If NULL, computed via CDI::size_factor().

nfeature

Integer number of informative feature genes to select via CDI::feature_gene_selection() (default 500L, per Fang et al., 2022).

method

Feature selection method passed to CDI::feature_gene_selection(): "wds" (Working Dispersion Score, default) or "vst".

zp_threshold

Numeric zero-proportion cutoff in (0, 1) used to pre-filter ultra-sparse features prior to WDS selection (default 0.95). Automatically relaxed for ultra-sparse modalities such as scATAC-seq.

lrt_pval_threshold

Numeric p-value threshold in (0, 1) for multi-batch LRT in CDI::calculate_CDI() (default 0.01).

max_cells

Maximum number of cells evaluated via proportional stratified subsampling across clusters (default 1000L; set Inf or NULL to evaluate all cells).

normalize_per_obs

Logical; if TRUE (default), divides raw CDI_AIC and CDI_BIC by \(N_{\mathrm{eval}} \times G_{\mathrm{selected}}\) so scores are scale-invariant across simulated datasets of differing dimensions.

threads

Integer number of parallel worker threads for BiocParallel (default 1L).

seed

Integer random seed used only during stratified cell subsampling (default 42L).

top_features

Optional deprecated alias for nfeature.

Value

A list containing:

cdi_aic

Per-observation normalized (or raw if normalize_per_obs = FALSE) CDI-AIC score (lower indicates better clustering, sensitive to subtypes).

cdi_bic

Per-observation normalized (or raw if normalize_per_obs = FALSE) CDI-BIC score (lower indicates better clustering, favors main cell types).

cdi_aic_raw

Unnormalized CDI_AIC returned directly by CDI::calculate_CDI().

cdi_bic_raw

Unnormalized CDI_BIC returned directly by CDI::calculate_CDI().

loglik

Total maximized NB log-likelihood (-neg_llk_val) across selected features.

n_clusters

Number of clusters evaluated.

n_features

Number of selected feature genes evaluated.

n_cells

Number of cells evaluated.

Details

To minimize time and space complexity from \(O(G \cdot N)\) dense allocations down to \(O(\mathrm{nnz}(X) + G_0 \cdot N_{\mathrm{eval}})\), sparse dgCMatrix inputs are stratified-subsampled across cells and pre-filtered by zero-proportion in sparse space prior to Working Dispersion Score (WDS) feature selection (CDI::feature_gene_selection), median-of-ratios size factor estimation (CDI::size_factor), and Negative Binomial MLE evaluation (CDI::calculate_CDI).

Examples

counts <- matrix(stats::rpois(1200, lambda = 3), nrow = 30, ncol = 40)
cl <- factor(rep(c("TypeA", "TypeB"), each = 20))
calc_cdi(counts, cl)
#> $cdi_aic
#> [1] 4.053388
#> 
#> $cdi_bic
#> [1] 4.222276
#> 
#> $cdi_aic_raw
#> [1] 4864.066
#> 
#> $cdi_bic_raw
#> [1] 5066.731
#> 
#> $loglik
#> [1] -2312.033
#> 
#> $n_clusters
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $n_features
#> [1] 30
#> 
#> $n_cells
#> [1] 40
#>
